<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth Survival Gear''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ホス・サバイバル・ギア</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の反乱軍か戦士に配備する。ホス上では、そのキャラクターは戦闘力と没収値が＋１となり、「凍傷」、「凍死」、「雪嵐」の影響を受けなくなる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Survival-Gear-PSA-156433116.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">エコー基地の兵員が着用する耐寒装備。これなしでは、ホスの苛酷な環境を生き抜くことはできない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth survival gear.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any Rebel or warrior. On Hoth, that character is power and forfeit +1 and is immune to Frostbite, Exposure and Ice Storm.

'''Lore:'''
Cold-weather gear worn by Echo Base troops. Without it they cannot survive Hoth's harsh environment.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth Survival Gear]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
